newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia names first culture minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombia names first culture minister.

text.p: President Ernesto Samper named former diplomat Ramiro Osorio as his first Culture Minister on Monday.
Osorio, 45, served as Colombian ambassador to Mexico in 1994 and was head of Colombia's Culture Institute between 1992 to 1993.

The Ministry of Culture was formally set up last month, a decision that has met with vociferous criticism, including from Nobel Laureate Gabriel Garcia Marquez. Critics say the ministry has no real defined role.
